name: guardrails
description: Stops risky shell commands before they run: killing ports owned by Docker containers, printing secrets from the environment, rewriting your kubeconfig, and asks before kubectl writes on production contexts.

productionPattern.title: Production context pattern
productionPattern.description: Regular expression that marks a kubectl context as production (case-insensitive).

confirmProductionWrites.title: Confirm kubectl writes on production
confirmProductionWrites.description: Ask before delete, scale, rollout, apply, patch, edit and exec into a Rails console on production contexts.

blockKubeconfigChanges.title: Block kubeconfig changes
blockKubeconfigChanges.description: Block commands that rewrite the kubeconfig (EKS update-kubeconfig, kubectl config use-context / set-context / delete-context).

blockSecretPrinting.title: Block printing secrets
blockSecretPrinting.description: Block env, printenv and echo of variables whose names look like secrets.

protectDockerPorts.title: Protect Docker ports
protectDockerPorts.description: Block kill/pkill on ports published by running Docker containers, and killing the Docker engine.
